releaseNotes:
### Desktop and Local Files

- Run the desktop application with a separately versioned local Agent backend while preserving the app identity and local data location.
- Open local HTML pages in the browser workspace and resolve chat and project file links with scoped access.
- Improve transcript positioning, message pairing, and layout stability across streaming and session switches.

### Models and Command Approvals

- Improve per-session model selection and reasoning controls, including OpenRouter and BuzzHive model synchronization.
- Reuse narrowly scoped command approvals within a session and inspect or revoke them from session settings.
- Strengthen command argument and shell policy checks while supporting local development servers.

### Project Activity and Upgrade

- Preserve project activity ordering when sessions are archived or deleted and when project metadata changes.
- Upgrade version 18 databases to version 19 with a transactional migration and an automatic pre-upgrade backup; existing version 19 databases need no new schema migration.
- Keep existing conversations and project data. Downgrading a version 19 database to Pudding 0.3.4 requires restoring the pre-upgrade backup.

### Licensing

- Publish Pudding Core under Apache-2.0 and distribute Pudding Desktop under a free-use proprietary license for personal and commercial use.
- Include the application license and third-party notices in the app bundle, with exact application-license verification during packaging.
